**Security: pass-with-notes** at `1b2710faf2b8e6aceb0c8c461a0366606d3ebb47`.

No reachable shell injection or C19/C21 disclosure found. The cap changes leave lock ownership, target confinement and disk-floor logic unchanged.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| 1 | ⚪ LOW | harness/scripts/shared-build.sh; justfile | 130-131; 20-21 | Override validation is partial: caller-supplied test threads and direct justfile exports are not positive-integer checked | 10/10 |

This is a nonblocking validation/diagnostic qualification, not demonstrated command execution. Bad overrides can reach Cargo/libtest rather than fail at the shared-build preflight; arbitrary caller-local diagnostic formatting is not escaped.

`PIJ_CARGO_JOBS` in shared-build defaults to 4 when unset/empty, rejects non-digits before arithmetic, converts leading-zero decimal input with `10#`, and requires a positive result before lock acquisition or cargo. Shell metacharacters, signs and whitespace cannot reach that arithmetic expression (`shared-build.sh:67,124-131`). Bash's fixed-width arithmetic has no explicit overflow/range guard here; this is not an arbitrary-precision or maximum-fleet-cap validator.

An explicit nonempty `RUST_TEST_THREADS` is passed through without equivalent checking. The justfile exports likewise copy environment strings directly. Both remain environment data: shell-variable expansion does not recursively execute embedded substitutions, and the printed shared-build line uses a fixed format with quoted `%s` arguments. Recipe echoes also double-quote their expansions. These values are not inserted into the script's command-evaluation text.

The complete four-file delta changes caps, diagnostics, documentation and focused tests only. Existing lock/disk-floor logic, cargo argv handling, scheduling wrappers and package locks are unchanged.

Local and remote heads agree; worktree clean; PR CLEAN and ready. Exact-head CI [42442545704](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42442545704) and [Delivers 42442545720](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42442545720) succeeded; all five checks passed. The Node 22 log confirms `shared-build.test.ts` passed 20/20, including exported default/override propagation and invalid-job refusal before lock/cargo. No dedicated hostile-thread-string or arithmetic-overflow regression was added. ddocs was UNAVAILABLE.

Source/CI review only. No local cargo, builds, tests or script execution, installs, credentials, edits or production/pane/process probes. This verdict does not authorize exceeding the current fleet-load limits.
